knownDifferences.reason: NW 7.4 SPS31 Windows table says em/max_size_MB = em/initial_size_MB; Note 88416 (Windows, v45 2024) and ABAP Platform say 1.5*PHYS_MEMSIZE. Calculator follows 88416. Verify with RSPARAM on a 7.4x Windows system.
NW 7.4 SPS31 Windows table says 2000000000; Note 88416 and ABAP Platform say 0 on Windows. Calculator follows 88416.
NW 7.4 SPS31 Windows table says max(PM*1024*1024*0.1, 2*heap_area_dia); Note 88416 says PM*1024*1024 on Windows. Calculator follows 88416.

Help (ABAP platform 2025) and Note 2085980 say rdisp/PG_MAXFS = rdisp/PG_SHM. RSPARAM of four real systems (Linux/Windows, ECC/S4) shows a fixed 256000 - on Linux ECC PG_SHM is 253600 while PG_MAXFS is 256000. Calculator follows the systems.
